Their commitment to emotional depth and realism helps transform the series into a compelling exploration of love, loss, and legacy against a rugged rural backdrop.

snippet.title: How the Music of Daredevil: Born Again Defines the Show
snippet.description:
In this behind-the-scenes feature, composers Andy Grush and Taylor Newton Stewart, known as The Newton Brothers, dive into the creative process behind the soundtrack of Daredevil: Born Again, explaining how they used music to reflect the emotional depth of the characters and the city's presence. They discuss key scenes, including how they crafted the sound for Daredevil's heightened senses, the emotional tension in Frank Castle’s arc, and the chaotic intensity of the fight sequences.
